context: A coach briefs his team before a tournament
purpose: Teach: オリンピック/キャンプ/プレイヤー/ブロック/シュート/ゲスト/大勢/進ま

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: よし、全員集合。今日からの合宿キャンプで一気に仕上げるぞ。
lines.en: Alright, everyone gather. We'll polish everything in this training camp starting today.
lines.style: Firm commanding tone with crisp authoritative delivery

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コーチ、相手チームにオリンピック代表の選手がいるって本当ですか?
lines.en: Coach, is it true the opposing team has an Olympic representative player?
lines.style: Nervous teenage curiosity with slightly anxious upward inflection

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本当だ。向こうには主力プレイヤーが揃ってる。だがビビるな。
lines.en: It's true. Their main players are all assembled. But don't get scared.
lines.style: Reassuring but stern, projecting steady veteran confidence

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 正直、シュート練習がなかなか思うように進まなくて不安なんです。
lines.en: Honestly, my shooting practice hasn't been progressing as I hoped, so I'm worried.
lines.style: Soft hesitant confession with downcast youthful sincerity

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: だから今夜は元日本代表をゲストコーチに招いてある。学べる事は全部吸収しろ。
lines.en: That's why I've invited a former national team member as a guest coach tonight. Absorb everything you can learn.
lines.style: Motivating mentor voice with deliberate emphatic pacing

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: えっ、本物が来るんですか!? 相手のブロックの抜き方も教われますかね。
lines.en: What, a real pro is coming!? Could we even learn how to break through the opponent's block?
lines.style: Excited teenage outburst with rising surprised energy

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: もちろんだ。会場には大勢の観客も来る。お前たちらしく戦え。以上、解散!
lines.en: Of course. A huge crowd will be at the venue too. Fight like yourselves. That's all, dismissed!
lines.style: Booming closing command with rallying coach finality
